subject: About the lasers
body:
You've built a forge that runs on lasers. Before you switch it on, walk along the beam and look at what's behind the target. I blew a huge hole through the Lab's iron walls that way. Look, I even drew you a picture. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:tech_laser @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/laser

Your old friend,
Dr. T
